facts.text: General education coursework for undergraduate degree programs is delivered through a partnership with Batten University (formerly Virginia Wesleyan University), allowing students to register directly through VCC without a separate application.

sources.title: Undergrad Cert in Biblical & Theological Studies | Virginia Christian College
sources.quote: General Education courses are offered through VCC's partner institution, Batten University (formerly Virginia Wesleyan University). These courses are delivered through a shared platform, allowing students to register directly through VCC without a separate application or enrollment process.
